name: AI Autoplayer
description: Adds an AI button to the level page that plays the level until it beats it, then saves the winning run to your PC.

turbo.name: Turbo (Speed Hack)
turbo.description: While the AI is searching, run as many game updates as fit in each frame and rewind instantly on death. Much faster than normal speed. The saved run is unaffected.

turbo-budget-ms.name: Turbo Budget (ms per frame)
turbo-budget-ms.description: How many milliseconds of each frame Turbo spends simulating. Higher = faster AI, but the game window gets choppier.

skip-repeats.name: Skip Repeated Situations
skip-repeats.description: Remember every situation (position, speed, gamemode, moment) that led nowhere and skip it instantly if it comes up again. Makes the AI much smarter; only turn it off if it gets stuck in a weird way.

fine-timing.name: Frame-Perfect Timing
fine-timing.description: If none of the normal click timings work, try clicking/releasing on every single physics tick (1/240 s). Needed for tight orbs, waves and frame-perfects.

segment-ticks.name: Decision Segment (ticks)
segment-ticks.description: How many physics ticks (240 per second) are between the AI's checkpoints. Smaller = finer control and shorter rewinds.

input-resolution.name: Quick Timings per Segment
input-resolution.description: How many click moments per segment the AI tries first, before falling back to frame-perfect timing.

sim-speed.name: Game Speed (when Turbo is off)
sim-speed.description: Speeds the game up while the AI is searching if Turbo is turned off (1 = normal speed).

max-attempts.name: Max Attempts
max-attempts.description: The AI gives up after this many deaths (skipped repeats don't count).

playback-practice.name: Replay in Practice Mode
playback-practice.description: Play saved AI runs back in practice mode so they never count as a real completion (recommended).

show-status.name: Show AI Status
show-status.description: Show the attempt counter, progress and speed while the AI plays.
